description: How subtyping of a part relates to subtyping of the whole. Return types are covariant, function parameters are contravariant.
When one `infer` variable receives several candidates, covariant positions produce a union and contravariant positions produce an intersection.
`(U extends unknown ? (arg: U) => void : never) extends (arg: infer I) => void ? I : never`.
An intersection of function types such as `((a: string) => string) & ((a: number) => number)` accepts every listed signature.
